# Crown Media Group

> AI-powered, faith-driven marketing agency based in Columbia, SC. Founded by David King (@mkdavidking). All Glory to Jesus.

Crown Media Group is a full-service digital marketing agency serving local businesses in Columbia, South Carolina. We specialize in AI-generated content, social media management, paid advertising, brand identity design, and AI video production. We deliver professional-grade marketing at a fraction of traditional agency costs — and we get it done in 48 hours.

## About

Crown Media Group was founded by David King, a 27-year-old faith-driven entrepreneur and CEO of All Glory to Jesus Global LLC. The agency combines cutting-edge AI marketing tools with a personal, local approach rooted in integrity and excellence. Every deliverable must pass the Philippians 4:8 filter: true, honorable, right, pure, lovely, of good repute, excellent, and worthy of praise.

## Services

- **Social Media Management** — Content creation, scheduling, and community engagement across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn
- **Paid Advertising** — Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads, full analytics and monthly reporting
- **AI Video Production** — Professional video ads created with AI tools, delivered in 24–48 hours
- **Brand Identity Design** — Logos, color palettes, typography systems, brand guidelines
- **E-Commerce Setup** — Shopify and custom store builds with payment integration
- **Website Design** — Mobile-first landing pages and business websites
- **Google Business Profile Optimization** — Local SEO, review management, entity optimization
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)** — On-page SEO, technical SEO, content strategy, local search rankings
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** — Structured data, FAQ schema, AI crawler optimization, entity consistency so AI assistants recommend your business
- **Email Marketing** — Campaigns, sequences, and list growth
- **Online Reputation Strategy** — Review generation, sentiment monitoring

## Pricing

- **Starter Package**: $750/month + $250 one-time setup fee
- **Growth Package**: $1,200/month + $400 one-time setup fee
- **Premium Package**: $3,500/month + $1,000 one-time setup fee
- **Add-ons**: Ad management (10–15% of spend) | Landing pages ($300–$800) | Ads Audit ($97–$197)
